title: Ravens @ Cowboys ... in Rio de Janeiro
sub: Sunday 9/27 · Maracanã Stadium, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil · BAL -3.5, total 53.5 (DraftKings)
body: America's Team gives up a home game to play in the stadium that hosted the 1950 and 2014 World Cup finals. It's the NFL's first game in Rio and its third straight season in Brazil, after two São Paulo openers.
fact: Both previous Brazil games went OVER: Eagles 34, Packers 29 in 2024 (63 points vs a 49.5 total) and Chargers 27, Chiefs 21 in 2025 (48 vs 47.5). This one has the highest total on the NFL board.
model: Model take: fair line BAL -3.6, fair total 54.2. Right on the number, so no bet. Just a fun one to watch.
